IDENT.title: Digital Twin Based SUDIHA Architecture to Smart Shopfloor Scheduling
IDENT.venue: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: Adopted Wooldridge/Russell agent model: an agent perceives its environment through sensors and acts upon it through actuators.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: An agent perceives its environment through sensors and acts upon that environment through actuators.

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: we used an Agent Model developed by Wooldridge [42] and Russel [43]

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: This architecture incorporates three Holons: Product Holon, Resource Holon and Order Holon

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: three Holons: Product Holon, Resource Holon and Order Holon

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: The agent program involves reasoning based on a knowledge base to select better actions.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: The structure of Order Holon includes a BDI Belief-Desire-Intention model, a decision maker and a communication manager

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: The scheduling architecture was only valid if the cell included only a small number of workstations and if the number of work orders launched was low.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: a decision maker and a communication manager (see Figure 4)

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: CIROS Supervision [46] and CIROS Simulation 2008 version [47] software were used

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: Each Resource Holon is provided with a library of standard tasks it can run.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Product data structure tracks product state; transport data structure stores carrier status; library of standard tasks.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: The Product Identiﬁcation was associated with a data structure that tracks the state of the product during production.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: These data were updated each time a Carrier arrived at a station.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: The data structure saved the Transport Carrier’s status.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: an RFID tag attached to the product or product carrier allows the virtual product to be synchronized with the real product

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: Smart products must be able to know their process plans and the type of machine needed to perform each operation.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: HLC and LLC communicate, generally through OPC or TCP-IP drivers.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The scheduling solution is the result of Holon interactions. This interaction consists of a message exchange between Holons.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: combines global supervision, achieved by Product Holon, with dynamic local control, achieved by Resource Holon

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: the scheduling module was invoked, which applied a Genetic Algorithm to propose a scheduling plan

E_LEARNING__uses_simulation_for_explorat.evidence_quote: This plan was simulated in CIROS Simulation before being sent to the Resource Holon for execution.

E_LEARNING__simulation_model_source.evidence_quote: A manufacturing operations plan will be simulated and, based on the simulation results, the Digital Twin model of the shopﬂoor will be updated.

F_DT_COUPLING__dt_present_in_work.evidence_quote: Each Holon of DT-SUDIHA will consist of a physical part and a virtual part.

F_DT_COUPLING__agent_dt_coupling.evidence_quote: It is generally implemented in SCADA software; it is the Virtual counterpart of the Resource.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: The DT-SUDIHA architecture was applied to the ﬂexible machining cell at the High School of engineering ENSAM.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: dynamic scheduling that can handle random disruptions such as failures, raw material shortages and quality defects

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: applied to the ﬂexible machining cell

H_STANDARDS__standards_referenced.evidence_quote: MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) and MTConnect are some of the preliminary outcomes

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: We were inspired by the model of the Product Agent architecture proposed by Kovalenko [44]

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Adds supervised OPT bottleneck detection, Kanban/ConWip, priority rules and GA-based rescheduling validated by DT simulation (CIROS), rather than capability discovery and negotiation.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: Each time a workpiece was processed or a disruption occurred, the scheduling module was invoked, which applied a Genetic Algorithm

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Claims DT must contain control programs and use real-time-data simulation.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: DT must then use simulations based on real time data acquisition.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: We were inspired by the model of the Product Agent architecture proposed by Kovalenko [44]
